changelog:
RoboHire skill v1.0.0 initial release:

- Introduces RoboHire, an AI-powered end-to-end recruitment agent platform.
- Automates up to 80% of the hiring process, from role brief to final shortlist.
- Features include AI recruiting consultant, job description generator, resume screening, automated interview invites, AI video interviewer, and multi-agent evaluation.
- Provides key stats, pricing plans, usage instructions, and links.
- Serves as a quick-reference knowledge base for product info, use cases, and feature documentation.
